description: Curated requests for the AI matching pipeline, against the seeded Customer Needs. expectedNeed is a seeded Need title (null for new).

cases.title: Export dashboard to Excel
cases.why: Finance reconciles shipping costs in spreadsheets every Monday; today we copy numbers by hand.
cases.expectedNeed: Use product data outside the platform

cases.title: Download all shipments as CSV
cases.why: We need the raw data in our own reporting tools for month-end close.
cases.expectedNeed: Use product data outside the platform

cases.title: SAML single sign-on
cases.why: Security requires central offboarding through our identity provider.

cases.title: Night theme
cases.why: Dispatchers on night shifts find the white dashboard too bright.

cases.title: Alert when a shipment breaches its SLA
cases.why: We hear about late shipments from our customers before we see them.
cases.expectedNeed: Know about delays before customers do

cases.title: Bulk edit carrier rates
cases.why: Rate cards change every quarter for hundreds of lanes and we edit them one by one.
cases.expectedNeed: Update many carrier rates at once

cases.title: Push weekly KPIs into Power BI automatically
cases.why: Leadership reviews KPIs in Power BI; a scheduled feed would replace the manual export.
cases.expectedNeed: Use product data outside the platform

cases.title: Provision users automatically from Okta
cases.why: IT spends hours creating and removing accounts by hand.

cases.title: Predict ETA slips from weather data
cases.why: We want to anticipate late deliveries days ahead, not just get an SLA alert.
cases.expectedNeed: Know about delays before customers do

cases.title: Compare carrier rate cards side by side
cases.why: Before uploading new rates we want to see which lanes got more expensive.
cases.expectedNeed: Update many carrier rates at once

cases.title: Scheduled audit report by email
cases.why: Our auditors want a monthly report emailed to them without logging in.
cases.expectedNeed: Use product data outside the platform

cases.title: Mobile app for drivers
cases.why: Drivers need to confirm pickups from their phone at the dock.

cases.title: Multi-language interface
cases.why: Our warehouse staff in Poland and Spain struggle with an English-only UI.

cases.title: Carbon footprint per shipment
cases.why: Our sustainability team must report CO2 emissions per customer every quarter.

cases.title: Invoice disputes workflow
cases.why: Billing disagreements are handled over email and get lost.

cases.title: Warehouse slot booking
cases.why: Trucks arrive at the same time and queue for hours at the gate.

cases.title: Better reports
cases.why: The reports page doesn't give us what we need.
cases.expectedNeed: Use product data outside the platform

cases.title: Easier login
cases.why: People forget their passwords all the time.

cases.title: Notifications
cases.why: We want to be told when something important happens.

cases.title: Faster updates for carriers
cases.why: Carriers complain it takes us too long to change things.
cases.expectedNeed: Update many carrier rates at once
